title: Mallworld transportation
content: Has anyone ever hopped in a car to get to or away from certain areas. Everytime I try I can only drive regularly for a short period. Feels like it's frowned upon like I'm getting overridden. Slowly I'll start feeling more in more like im driving from the back seat like if I stretch my legs I can only scarcely tap the petals. Sometimes I straight up end up in the back seat like fuck do I gotta jump over the seat and hit the pedal with my hands. When I get back there the car doesn't like slow down and ghost ride it stays going fast.
